command:
set -eu
BASE=/workspace/omega_runtime/extensions/ingress_v3
LOG=/workspace/omega_runtime/state/logs/ingress_gateway_v3.log
umask 077
tmux new-session -d -s omega-ingress-v3-canary "cd $BASE && PYTHONPATH=. exec python3 -m omega.ingress_gateway serve --owner gabriel --machine omega-vps --port 8788 >>$LOG 2>&1"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.request,time
token=Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/private/ingress-gabriel.token').read_text().strip()
req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8788/v1/health',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token})
for _ in range(15):
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=2) as resp:
   print('CANARY',resp.status)
   break
 except Exception:time.sleep(.2)
else:raise AssertionError('CANARY_UNAVAILABLE')
PY
tmux kill-session -t omega-ingress-v3-canary
tmux has-session -t omega-ingress
tmux kill-session -t omega-ingress
tmux new-session -d -s omega-ingress "cd $BASE && PYTHONPATH=. exec python3 -m omega.ingress_gateway serve --owner gabriel --machine omega-vps --port 8787 >>$LOG 2>&1"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.request,time
token=Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/private/ingress-gabriel.token').read_text().strip()
req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/health',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token})
for _ in range(20):
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=2) as resp:
   print('ACTIVE_V3',resp.status)
   break
 except Exception:time.sleep(.25)
else:raise AssertionError('V3_NOT_READY_RESTORE_INGRESS_V2')
PY
